data.title: The Horizon
data.about:
One of six iconic towers in the Sobha Central project, The Horizon offers a refined standard of urban living. Located along the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this striking residential tower by Sobha Realty offers residents seamless access to Dubai’s most dynamic districts. With sleek architectural lines and thoughtfully crafted interiors, the tower captures panoramic skyline views while ensuring everyday comfort.

The Horizon at Sobha Central features a curated selection of 1 and 2-bedroom apartments designed for both serenity and style. Residents can indulge in a premium lifestyle through a range of upscale offerings. Whether it’s a dip in the swimming pool, a family gathering at the BBQ space, or enjoying the outdoor cinema under the stars, this address is built for balance, connection, and convenience.

characteristics_module.title: The Horizon at Sobha Central by Sobha Realty – Where Lifestyle Meets Landmark Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Sheikh Zayed Road Location – Enjoy unmatched access to Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, DIFC and Business Bay.
  • Integrated Lifestyle Amenities – From pools to BBQs, enjoy resort-style living at home.
  • Developed by Sobha Realty – Backed by a legacy of precision, design, and award-winning quality.
  • High Return on Investment – Located in a high-demand urban corridor with strong rental and resale potential.
  • Seamless Lifestyle Access – Direct connectivity to retail, entertainment, and everyday conveniences.
  • Flexible 60/40 Payment Plan – Spread your investment with staged payments and 40% due on handover.
  • Podium-Level Urban Park – Elevated green space with community views and panoramic openness.
  • Architectural Excellence – A sleek vertical icon with natural light-optimized layouts.

location_tile.title: Central, Connected, and Iconic
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Set on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), The Horizon at Sobha Central by Sobha Group offers residents a unique vantage point in the city's ever-evolving skyline. With effortless access to various important areas and destinations, this location seamlessly combines urban pace with daily ease.

  • 5 Minutes – Jumeirah Lakes Towers
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 15 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes – Business Bay
  • 20 Minutes – Downtown Dubai
